text:
How much is a top 3 spot on Google worth to you?

Grab a pen.
Your average job: say AUD$900.
Extra jobs a week from the map: say two.

That's AUD$1,800 a week. About AUD$93,000 a year.

Put in your own numbers. Now you know what that spot is worth to you.

Search "electrician Rockingham" on your phone.

Look at the first three businesses on the map.

Every call they get from that search is a call you don't get.

That's what a top 3 spot is worth. Their phone rings instead of yours.

Plumber in Joondalup posts a hot water special on his Google Business Profile.
Last line: "Call Dave on 0400..."

Google knocks it back.

Google can remove posts with a phone number, email or social handle in the text.

Take the number out. Use the "Call now" button instead.
